Name: (FS) Vanilla Hats Extended
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
[size=4]I always wondered, if I could combine Stardew Valley's hats with other Fashion Sense [i](FS)[/i] items. However, since the hats themselves haven't been added to FS by other mods [i](as far as I know)[/i] I decided to do it myself and a few variants too while I'm at it!
This also saves you the trouble of unlocking certain hats through achievements or other conditions.

[b][u]In short:[/u][/b] this mod adds all [u]122 base-game hats,[/u] [u]35 alternate versions[/u] for a selection of those hats and extra versions with full color customization.[/size]


[center][color=#e69138][size=6][u][b]There are 4 versions total to choose from![/b][/u][/size][/color][/center]
[size=4]Here are short descriptions of each version:

[b]Accessory Version[/b]
﻿- ﻿Adds vanilla hats into the "Accessory" tab
﻿- Full color customization
[/size][size=4]
[b]Hat Version[/b]
﻿- ﻿Adds vanilla hats into the "Accessory" tab
﻿- Full color customization

[b]Original Accessory Version[/b]
﻿- Adds vanilla hats into the "Accessory" tab
﻿- Hats keep their original coloring
﻿- No color customization

[/size][size=4][b]Original Accessory Version[/b]
﻿- ﻿Adds vanilla hats into the "Hat" tab
﻿- Hats keep their original coloring
﻿- No color customization[/size]


[center][color=#e69138][size=6][b][u]Notes[/u][/b][/size][/color][color=#e69138][size=5][b][u]
[/u][/b][/size][/color][/center][list]
[*][size=4]You can download all 4 versions together. However, i recommend against doing so, since the amount of clothing items will clutter your FS selections.[/size]
[size=4][/size][/list][list]
[*][size=4]If you wish to trim down the selection of included hats, then go to the mod's folders labeled "[FS] Vanilla Hats Extended" [i](there may be multiple, if you downloaded more than one version)[/i] and delete the hats you don't intend to use.[/size]
[size=4][/size][/list][list]
[*][size=4]I personally recommend downloading the "Accessory Version" and/or "Original Accessory Version", since accessories can be combined with other accessories. This allows more room for creativity when assembling an outfit![/size]
[/list]
[list]
[*][size=4]None of the hats hide your farmer's hair, which will likely cause "clipping". I recommend you to look for mods that add hair to Fashions Sense, so that you can choose a fitting hairstyle while you're assembling an outfit with FS.



[/size]
[center]And that would be all! Thank you for at least considering to download/endorse this mod.

[b]Now go on and have a good one of whatever you feel like![/b][/center][b]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿[color=#00ffff] ﻿- Tea-Loving Lad[/color][/b][/list]
